description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Level1Result" name="Level 1 scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delayed notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FinalResult" name="Final scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Participant_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Level1Result" name="Level 1 result" messageRef="Msg_Level1Result"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FinalResult" name="Final result" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequested" name="Clerk requests credit scoring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ScoringResponse_Split" name="Agency response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <!-- Immediate level 1 result path -->
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Level1Result" name="Level 1 result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level1Result" messageRef="Msg_Level1Result"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentResult_Immediate" name="Present result to clerk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultPresented" name="Result presented">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Delayed scoring path -->
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotification" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" name="Display message to clerk: check again later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Final result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FinalResult" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentResult_Delayed" name="Present result to clerk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultPresentedAfterDelay" name="Result presented after delay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse_Split" targetRef="Catch_Level1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ScoringResponse_Split" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Catch_Level1Result" targetRef="Task_PresentResult_Immediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult_Immediate" targetRef="End_ResultPresented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotification" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Catch_FinalResult" targetRef="Task_PresentResult_Delayed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult_Delayed" targetRef="End_ResultPresentedAfterDelay"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
